questions: What is the smallest decidability fix?
Why does CI not enforce the lock?

findings.claim: Lock stores hashes only; DRIFT prints two words; the audited bytes are unrecoverable when carry-forward edits land before commit.
CI asymmetry measured: 7 of 134 lock records tracked; .gitignore:18 covers the directory; legacy records carry pre-172 absolute paths (boundary hazard on bulk un-ignore).
Direction 3 design: snapshots at capture, bounded diff on DRIFT, per-session force-add into the seal ceremony; legacy tolerance; Direction 1 and CI job as follow-ons.
